descriptions.tsonnet_c33_poll_dispatch_801fdbec: Calls two external service routines, then maps the status code returned by a third (5, 4, 6, 11 and -1 to states 1 to 5, status 2 leaves the state unchanged, anything else sets 0) into the word at offset 0, and finally calls the function pointer at offset 4 with that state if it is set, or an external default handler with the object otherwise; state values and meanings are inferred.
